$comment: Shared table for the two CSAF minLength:1 text sinks in hdf-to-csaf-vex. Read by both converters/hdf-to-csaf-vex/go/schema_validation_test.go and converters/hdf-to-csaf-vex/typescript/schema-validation.test.ts so the Go and TS rules are asserted against one definition and cannot drift apart.

referenceSummary.$comment: references[].summary is required with minLength 1, while the HDF evidence description and externalReference description that back it are optional. The documented fallback is the reference URL itself — the only text the reference always carries; a placeholder would assert a description the source never gave.

cases.name: an absent description falls back to the url
a whitespace-only description is not text
a padded description keeps its padding

reasonProse.$comment: The override reason with the machine-written 'Products:' line removed. It feeds threats[].details and notes[].text, both required with minLength 1, so an empty result means the element is omitted, never emitted blank.

cases.name: the products line is stripped from prose
cases.reason:
Accepted risk pending vendor patch
Products: CSAFPID-0001, CSAFPID-0002

cases.name: a products-only reason leaves no details
an empty reason leaves no details
a whitespace-only reason leaves no details
